# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance.

opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated

ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.

  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.

  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.

  care.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]

Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. Skip to content

accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our

[ Who we are ][82]

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Introducing
# Keenova and Par Health

On July 31, 2025, Mallinckrodt and Endo joined together to better serve patients and customers with
a bold plan for the future. Following the merger, the combined company then spun off its generics
and sterile injectables business as an independent company—Par Health—and rebranded the specialty
therapeutics company as Keenova Therapeutics in November 2025. 

Today, Keenova and Par Health operate as separate companies, each with its own mission and identity.
Please select the one you would like to visit.

Keenova strives to help patients with rare, stigmatized, or unaddressed conditions live happier and
healthier lives. Our areas of focus include, among others, immunology, urology, hepatology,
ophthalmology, orthopedics, and critical care.

[ Keenova.com ][6]

Par Health is the essential pharmaceutical company. We develop high-quality generics, sterile
injectables, and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), supported by a robust, U.S.-advantaged
manufacturing network. With over 4,000 team members worldwide, we believe great healthcare is built
on getting the essentials right.

Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.

  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary

ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

[ View MicroDEP ][52]
[ All Technologies ][53]

## Who We Are

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding
therapeutic potential and redefining what’s possible for patients. As one of the first pioneers in
film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

[ ABOUT ARx ][54]

## Product Development & Commercialization

ARx supports every stage of the drug development lifecycle. From formulation to commercial
manufacturing, we expedite timelines and improve patient outcomes with an eye for optimizing safety
and effectiveness.

**Process Development**

We accelerate filing and commercialization processes with scalable manufacturing. Using QbD
principles, we optimize production with yields and regulatory approval in mind.

**Commercial Manufacturing**

ARx produces over 100 million units annually in FDA-registered cGMP facilities. We guarantee a
reliable supply of high-quality films and patches from launch through ongoing production.

**Quality Management**

Quality comes first. At ARx, we prioritize transparency and QC, ensuring compliance at each stage in
your development process.

**Analytical Testing**

Every ARx product is driven by advancing patient health. We thoroughly test formulations on-site to
ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

## Technologies

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

[ View MicroDEP ][52]
[ All Technologies ][53]

## Who We Are

ARx specializes in developing novel, innovative drug delivery systems that improve control of drug
release and absorption, bioavailability, as well as patient experience and safety, expanding
therapeutic potential and redefining what’s possible for patients. As one of the first pioneers in
film and adhesive polymer science and novel dosing strategies, we’ve helped shape modern drug
delivery through higher standards for quality, safety and efficacy.

[ ABOUT ARx ][54]

## Product Development & Commercialization

ARx supports every stage of the drug development lifecycle. From formulation to commercial
manufacturing, we expedite timelines and improve patient outcomes with an eye for optimizing safety
and effectiveness.

**Process Development**

We accelerate filing and commercialization processes with scalable manufacturing. Using QbD
principles, we optimize production with yields and regulatory approval in mind.

**Commercial Manufacturing**

ARx produces over 100 million units annually in FDA-registered cGMP facilities. We guarantee a
reliable supply of high-quality films and patches from launch through ongoing production.

**Quality Management**

Quality comes first. At ARx, we prioritize transparency and QC, ensuring compliance at each stage in
your development process.

**Analytical Testing**

Every ARx product is driven by advancing patient health. We thoroughly test formulations on-site to
ensure they meet product specifications and the highest clinical standards.

**Product Development**

ARx is driven by collaboration. We work hand-in-hand with partners to design, develop and bring
life-changing products to market and fulfill subsequent demand.

[ EXPLORE ARx SERVICES ][55]

## Therapeutic Areas

Patients with complex conditions need drug delivery systems that are precise, customized, and
adaptable. Standard methods often fail to provide consistent dosing, improved absorption, and
sustained effects. ARx designs tailored delivery systems that improve drug bioavailability while
avoiding first-pass metabolism and accommodating complex conditions to improve patient quality of
life.

Our solutions cover the following therapeutic areas:
* Parkinson's
* Alzheimer’s
* Cancer
* Opioid Addiction
* Chronic Pain
* Obesity

### Parkinson's Disease

Controlled-release systems provide reliable, consistent dosing, helping patients manage Parkinson's
disease more effectively while supporting better adherence and quality of life.

### Alzheimer’s Disease

Alternative delivery methods ensure steady absorption and consistent dosing, supporting long-term
management of Alzheimer’s disease and cognitive function.

### Cancer

Controlled, consistent drug delivery reduces dosing frequency and side effects, improving comfort
for cancer patients throughout treatment.

### Opioid Addiction

Alternative dosing systems enhance adherence and provide steady medication delivery, supporting
recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

### Chronic Pain

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

### Obesity

Oral thin films and transdermal patches offer discreet, easy-to-use delivery options, helping
patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

### MTC-Y™
### Semi-Solid Carrier

## Biotts is a biotech company specializing in **Transdermal Drug Delivery**

Our proprietary **Multifunctional Transdermal Carrier Y (MTC-Y™)** technology allows for the
transdermal delivery of both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules, that are much larger in size than
traditional transdermal technologies, like peptides and proteins (up to 6000 Da. so far). This opens
a whole new window of opportunity to the pharmaceutical industry and their patients to get the
benefits from transdermal drug delivery like needle-free administration, sustained dosage, and
increased bioavailability with a wide range of active ingredients.

**Biotts develop its own transdermal drug products and make their expertise and technology available
to the pharmaceutical industry through technical development collaborations.**

Transdermal drug delivery

## **Pushing the limits**
## Biotts is making
## Transdermal Drug Delivery:

a viable** alternative **to oral
drugs and injectables

a benefit to improve
**the quality of life **
for millions of patients

Transdermal drug delivery
Transdermal drug delivery

## Traditional
## **transdermal limitations**

Transdermal Drug Delivery has traditionally been limited by the skin’s tough and lipid rich outer
layer known as the stratum corneum thus rendering the skin impermeable to most biopharmaceuticals;
of the thousands of drugs currently approved by the FDA less than 30 are approved for transdermal
delivery. So far, successful transdermal drug delivery has only been accomplished with small
molecules (< 500 Da.) that are moderately lipophilic.

## Enhanced drug delivery
## with **MTC-Y™**

**The development of Biotts’ proprietary MTC-Y™ technology has effectively removed these
limitations, without the use of complicated devices or invasive technologies.**

The MTC-Y™ carrier system is a semisolid emulsion that stimulates the transportation through the
skin and can carry both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules of up to 6,000 Da. such as peptides and
proteins into the bloodstream. MTC-Y™ allows drugs to quickly penetrate the skin without irritating
it.

[The Technology][10]

## **Improving**
## patient outcomes

**Biotts’ MTC-Y™ technology completely changes what is possible with Transdermal Drug Delivery,
making it a much more feasible alternative. **

It offers the fast onset of action of an injectable, but at more constant drug levels and in a way
that is much less invasive. Furthermore, it allows for reduced administration frequency and
increased self-administration, and with that improved quality of life for patients. It also offers
the convenience of an oral pill, but with a much more controlled and sustained release profile,
improved bioavailability, and dramatically reduced side-effects. The results are a significantly
improved performance compared to existing transdermal and topical products, and unlimited
opportunities for new transdermal product development.

The Science

### What Makes Chitosan Different?

**Chitosan** is a natural substance and a **biopolymer** derived from chitin. Chitin is the second
most abundant natural material after cellulose. It is a structural sugar found in shellfish shells,
insect exoskeletons, fungi and certain algae.

Unlike most naturally occurring sugars, chitosan can carry a **positive charge**. Many pathogens,
microplastics, dietary fats, heavy metals and other unwanted compounds are negatively charged.

+

This electrostatic difference allows chitosan to attract, bind or interact with many negatively
charged substances across biological and environmental systems.

This makes chitosan particularly valuable in antimicrobial systems, digestive-health formulations,
toxin-binding applications, water purification, agriculture and advanced biomedical materials.

Functional Benefits

### How Chitosan Supports Health and Purification

Chitosan's polymer structure and ionic activity make it useful in several important health,
nutritional and environmental applications.

01

#### Dietary Fiber Support

Chitosan may serve as a natural dietary fiber ingredient that supports digestive-health and gut
microbiome formulations for humans and animals.

Digestive Health
02

#### Toxin Binding

Its polymer structure enables chitosan powder to interact with toxins and other unwanted compounds
within digestive and purification systems.

Binding Technology
03

#### Heavy Metal Removal

Chitosan can interact with negatively charged metals, including lead, arsenic, mercury and cadmium,
making it valuable in environmental purification.

## They're slow. They're expensive.

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."

to make their calls?

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

How it works

## Two sides publish. Hell of a Partner matches.

A brand posts the distribution it needs. A distributor posts the capability it offers. Hell of a
Partner scores the fit and brokers the introduction.

Manufacturer / Brand

Publishes a distribution offer
* Product lines to place

### Hell of a Partner, the platform

It scores every distributor against each brand's offer on seven weighted criteria, then brokers the
introduction. Contact details stay private until the request is accepted.

Distributor / Importer / Agent

Publishes a capability profile
* Markets and territories covered
* Sales channels operated
* Customer base already served
* Product categories handled
* Certifications held

What makes it different

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational
marketplaces never list: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops, cooperatives and
family farms. Each is checked against an official government registry or a recognized origin mark,
and sorted by category and country, so you can actually find and trust them.

[Browse the catalog by category and country →][8]
* Verified at the source
  
  Matched to official business registries (SIREN, CVR, RCCM and dozens more) or protected origin
  marks like PDO, GI and Genuine Jersey, not a self-declared badge.
* Sorted by category and country
  
  Find a specific product in a specific market instead of scrolling an endless, unfiltered list.
* Reachable even without a website
  
  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Matching engine

## Matching that explains itself

Every distributor is scored 0 to 100 against a manufacturer's offer on seven weighted criteria, with
a plain-language rationale, not a black box.
* 22%
  
  Country coverage
  
  Share of the manufacturer's target markets the distributor actively covers.
* 20%
  
  Category match
  
  Whether the distributor specialises in the offer's product category.
* 16%
  
  Sales channels
  
  Overlap between the requested sales channels and the distributor's channels.
* 13%
  
  Minimum order fit
  
  How comfortably the distributor's order capacity meets the minimum.
* 12%
  
  Certification fit
  
  Required certifications the distributor already holds.
* 9%
  
  Existing network fit
  
  Customer types served, brand portfolio size, partner-type match, and years in distribution.
* 8%
  
  Trade-agreement fit
  
  Preferential trade arrangements between the offer's target markets and the distributor's coverage
  (EAEU, EU, ASEAN, USMCA, CPTPP, AfCFTA, bilateral FTAs).

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

data, important feasibility and testing is done is called [preclinical drug development][55]. Main
aim of this is to determine the safe dose. 

[Preclinical drug development Journals][56] deals with the drug research before it is released into
the market.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

1970

### Invented the ComboPen® platform

Invented the ComboPen® platform to deliver medical countermeasures, which fueled autoinjector
innovations for anaphylaxis.

1959

### Created the emergency use autoinjector

Created the emergency use autoinjector, laying the groundwork for the ongoing refinement of
self-administered injectables currently used by millions of people worldwide.

1956

### Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI)

Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI) and kick-started the evolution of inhaled
therapies by developing an easy-to-use device for patients around the globe.

indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits

des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

**2026 Highlights:**
* 200+ Participation (70% Industry: 30% Academia)
* 9+ Keynote Speakers
* 30+ Plenary Speakers
* 3+ Exhibitors
* 14 Innovative Educational Sessions
* B2B Meetings

# Innovative Transdermal Technologies and Patient-Focused Pharmaceutical Products

[FIND OUT MORE ][17]

## Nutriband Company

At Nutriband and our subsidiaries, our core focus is to use innovative drug delivery systems and
devices to improve patient outcomes, specifically targeting the Global Opioid epidemic. Fentanyl and
other opioid-based transdermal medications unfortunately play a role in a significant number of
opioid deaths each year with no solution currently available. Working with our clinical
subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, we have developed a technology called AVERSA, which we believe, with FDA
approval, will revolutionize the safety standard for these medications and save countless lives per
year.

## DEVELOPING PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS

## Research & Innovation

Through our Clinical Subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, Our Company has capabilities for developing
pharmaceutical products from preclinical testing to clinical manufacturing and early-stage clinical
development (Phase I/II). A key company focus and area of expertise at 4P is in the development of
transdermal products for currently injected compounds, including proteins, peptides, macromolecules,
and biologics. Transdermal delivery of commercially available drugs or biologics that are typically
delivered by injection has the potential to improve safety, efficacy and therapeutic outcomes
associated with these treatments.

[home.jpg]

## Nutriband Subsidiaries

At Nutriband, we have two revenue-generating subsidiaries, 4P Therapeutics which focuses on clinical
research and development, and Pocono Pharmaceutical, which focuses on contract manufacturing, along
with Active Intelligence, which specializes in sports recovery products.

[home1.jpg]

4P Therapeutics is a clinical subsidiary of Nutriband Inc. (NTRB) focused on the research and
development of novel drug delivery technologies and therapeutics. 4P develops products that meet the
needs of patients, physicians and payers.

# PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery
SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

**Advanced microporation technology for the delivery of therapeutics and vaccines **

[Contact Us][20]

## The PassPort® System

[Transdermal comparison to oral drug delivery]

#### Why Transdermal Drug Delivery?

 Passive transdermal drug delivery is a convenient and effective way to administer a variety of
therapeutics. This route of administration is both noninvasive and produces steady drug delivery
over an extended period of time. 



While conventional transdermal systems (such as drug patches) have demonstrated the benefits of
delivering drugs via the skin, they only work for an extremely limited number of drugs. This is
because millions of dead skin cells form a protective barrier on the surface of the skin (the
stratum corneum) that prevents most therapeutic molecules from passing into the skin. Passive
transdermal patches are typically limited to lipid-soluble drugs with a molecular weight of less
than 500 daltons.



As a result of these limitations, researchers have explored a variety of methods to penetrate this
skin barrier - ranging from chemicals to lasers, microneedles, and ultrasound. However, many of
these technologies have drawbacks or other limitations. PassPort Technologies, Inc. is looking to
overcome these challenges via a novel transdermal microporation platform called the PassPort®
system.



[PassPort System - advanced drug delivery technology]

#### PassPort® Microporation Technology

The PassPort® system is a novel active transdermal technology platform that enables efficient
delivery of small molecule drugs, peptides, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleotides, and vaccines from
a small conventional skin patch.



The patented system is designed for simple application and self-administration. Pressing the
activation button of the applicator device releases a pulse of energy to the disposable porator. The
rapid conduction of this energy into the surface of the skin painlessly ablates the stratum corneum
under each porator filament to create microchannels. A simple transdermal patch containing the
active ingredient is then applied to the ablated skin and drug delivery begins. 



[How the PassPort System works]

#### How the Technology Works

 The PassPort® technology painlessly creates aqueous micropores in the stratum corneum within a few
milliseconds. These aqueous channels enable drugs to flow from a transdermal patch, enter the viable
epidermis, and then the systemic circulation. The patch may be formulated to provide for either
immediate or sustained delivery.



PassPort Technologies is developing transdermal alternatives to invasive injection formulations…
* Better patient compliance (needle-free drug delivery)
* Convenient for patients (at-home administration)
* Improvement of storage conditions (room temperature) using a dry patch formulation
* Easy dose discontinuation by patch removal
* Economically attractive costs of goods 
* Reduces needle disposal and needlestick injuries
* Improved pharmacoeconomics (reduced healthcare costs)
* New feature: electronic medication adherence control

## Pipeline



PassPort Technologies is developing a robust internal pipeline of off-patent drugs delivered via the
novel PassPort® system. The company's lead preclinical candidate is a CNS therapeutic in development
in the US via the 505(b)(2) pathway. This candidate is available for license.



In addition, PassPort Technologies has ongoing collaborations with leading multinational
pharmaceutical companies and academic groups. Details on these pipeline PassPort® candidates are
currently undisclosed.

Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &

# Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK | MHRA-Licensed Exporter to Africa and the Middle East

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is a pharmaceutical wholesaler UK and international buyers turn to
for compliant, export-ready medicines. We hold a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human) from the
MHRA and run to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards, from the point a product is sourced to
the day it leaves our facility near London Heathrow.
We buy from approved UK and European suppliers, hold stock in temperature-controlled storage, and
build each consignment with the paperwork institutional buyers and regulators actually ask for:

certificates of analysis, batch traceability, temperature logs, and full export documentation. Under
our licence we procure, hold, and export medicines to other businesses, never directly to the
public, and a designated Responsible Person oversees GDP compliance. We’re a licensed distributor
and exporter, not a manufacturer.

[Request GDP-Compliant Export Documentation][17]

## Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK With Global Export Reach

GPD has spent years coordinating supply for authorised importers, hospital groups, and government
health programmes in more than one region. Most of what we do is invisible to the patient at the end
of the chain, and that’s by design. Buyers stay with us because shipments arrive documented,
traceable, and ready for inspection, not because of a sales pitch.
Every product follows the same route: verified sourcing, GDP storage, and consignment preparation
under Responsible Person oversight, exactly as a WDA(H) requires. The MHRA inspects licensed sites
against GDP before a licence is granted and at intervals afterwards, so the standard is never
optional.

# Regulatory Affairs Services in Russia and Eurasian Union: Five Arguments for Pharegis

If you are planning to enter Russian or EAEU market with a new pharmaceutical product, sophisticated
medical device or just want to start selling your active pharmaceutical ingredients to Russian
partners, maybe you already realized that finding time-efficient, fully predictable and transparent
service provider, focused and dedicated to such projects in its experience would be optimal choice
for your business with long-term impact and perspective. Here are main reasons for how any service
solutions provided by us can be beneficial to your business in Russia and EAEU.

[Choose CRO for drug registration and approval in Russia, fast biosimilar and generics registration,
managing local clinical studies, bioequivalence and therapeutic equivalence, preclinical studies,
drug regulatory service in Russia - consider Pharegis]

## 1. Focused experience

We have over 15 years of extensive experience working with Russian Healthcare system namely
[Ministry of Health][32], [Federal Service for Surveillance in Healthcare (Roszdravnadzor)][33],
[Federal State Budgetary Institution ‘Scientific Centre for Expert Evaluation of Medicinal Products’
(FSBI ‘SCEEMP’)][34] and every other expertise authority responsible for registration of
pharmaceuticals and medical devices in Russia.

## 2. Client-oriented flexibility

We are dedicated to providing outstanding services to our Customers. Any question that really
concerns our  client can be discussed at top level with zero bureaucracy. We are trying our best to
be flexible and compliant to client needs at first, not processes or our SOPs, yet sophisticated,
specific and client-optimized.

## 3. Comprehensive expert approach

All our collaborators and experts are trained in international standards of business and
international industry standards. 100% of our experts have higher medical or pharmaceutical
education. Part of our staff have scientific degrees.

## 4. High ethical standards

Our ethics principles fully correspond to high industry standards established in top international
companies. We are adherent to anticorruption legislation and measures. You can fully trust us on
highly turbulent and Russian regulatory sphere.

## 5. Validity, predictability and quality of every process

We guarantee quality at every stage of our work. Our rule is: if quality of service at any step is
not 100% satisfying, a customer can get that step readjusted for free.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Welcome to the Research & Reviews - International Journals

We are an open-access journal publication that aims to serve authors and readers (scientists as well
as general masses) by providing them an easy and reliable source of knowledge. We publish 28
International Journals dispersing advance knowledge in the field of Pharmacy, Medical, Nursing,
Dental, Agriculture, Engineering Technology and Arts. Certified by American Montessori Council, we
have developed a unique education system that is a blend of our Ancient Vedic Educations with the
practice equipment of Montessori system.

We provide a wide range of standard articles that are published after a stringent peer-review
process along with expert’s updations and are appreciated by millions of readers all over the world
for our unbiased performance and quality output. Several countries contribute papers to our
journals. Each issue carries useful reviews and articles of immediate interest to the practicing
professionals as well as researchers.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.

  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,

ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

# Tailored pharmacokinetics, enhanced safety.

Reimagine what’s possible.

**WE ARE ARx.** Your drug delivery partner for what’s next.

Achieve next-generation absorption, precision and control while keeping the patient experience front
and center, with ARx. Your established partner in oral thin film and transdermal delivery systems.

[ Partner With Us ][49]

### Therapeutic Thin Film

Our oral thin films provide a convenient, easy-to-use platform for fast-acting, immediate-release
therapies that bypass first-pass metabolism. These dissolvable strips deliver medication directly
into the bloodstream through the oral mucosa, ensuring faster absorption, fewer side effects and a
more comfortable patient experience.
* Quick and precise drug delivery.
* Convenient design that eliminates swallowing difficulties.
* Customizable profiles for tailored therapeutic experiences.
* Improved bioavailability.
* Taste-masking options in various flavors.
* Easy transport and discreet administration.

[ Dosage Forms ][50]

### Transdermal Patches

Our transdermal patches deliver medication through a controlled-release system that penetrates the
skin and directly enters the bloodstream. By bypassing the digestive system and liver, they maintain
consistent drug levels, reducing the need for frequent doses and minimizing side effects.
* Non-invasive application for ease of use.
* Controlled release for consistent therapeutic levels.
* Avoidance of side effects from peaks and troughs of serum levels.
* Versatile options tailored for localized or systemic needs.
* Long-lasting wear reduces the frequency of dosing.
* Avoids first-pass metabolism and potential for GI side effects.

[ Dosage Forms ][51]

Our innovative technology platforms are designed to deliver better absorption and bioavailability
while improving the experience for patients.
**This includes MicroDEP, our breakthrough, patented method for rapid-onset delivery of ultra-low
doses through an oral thin film. **
* Precise dosing with as little as five micrograms.
* Fast absorption for quick onset of effects.
* Micro-sized deposits for targeted delivery.
* Enhanced bioavailability bypasses the digestive system.
* Customizable formulations for various APIs and needs.

for cancer patients throughout treatment.

recovery and reducing the risk of relapse.

Transdermal patches and oral thin films provide reliable pain relief, reducing dosing frequency and
minimizing side effects, making chronic pain management more manageable.

patients with obesity manage their treatment and improve adherence.

### MTC-Y™
### Semi-Solid Carrier

## Biotts is a biotech company specializing in **Transdermal Drug Delivery**

Our proprietary **Multifunctional Transdermal Carrier Y (MTC-Y™)** technology allows for the
transdermal delivery of both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules, that are much larger in size than
traditional transdermal technologies, like peptides and proteins (up to 6000 Da. so far). This opens
a whole new window of opportunity to the pharmaceutical industry and their patients to get the
benefits from transdermal drug delivery like needle-free administration, sustained dosage, and
increased bioavailability with a wide range of active ingredients.

**Biotts develop its own transdermal drug products and make their expertise and technology available
to the pharmaceutical industry through technical development collaborations.**

Transdermal drug delivery

## **Pushing the limits**
## Biotts is making
## Transdermal Drug Delivery:

a viable** alternative **to oral
drugs and injectables

a benefit to improve
**the quality of life **
for millions of patients

Transdermal drug delivery
Transdermal drug delivery

## Traditional
## **transdermal limitations**

Transdermal Drug Delivery has traditionally been limited by the skin’s tough and lipid rich outer
layer known as the stratum corneum thus rendering the skin impermeable to most biopharmaceuticals;
of the thousands of drugs currently approved by the FDA less than 30 are approved for transdermal
delivery. So far, successful transdermal drug delivery has only been accomplished with small
molecules (< 500 Da.) that are moderately lipophilic.

## Enhanced drug delivery
## with **MTC-Y™**

**The development of Biotts’ proprietary MTC-Y™ technology has effectively removed these
limitations, without the use of complicated devices or invasive technologies.**

The MTC-Y™ carrier system is a semisolid emulsion that stimulates the transportation through the
skin and can carry both lipophilic and hydrophilic molecules of up to 6,000 Da. such as peptides and
proteins into the bloodstream. MTC-Y™ allows drugs to quickly penetrate the skin without irritating
it.

[The Technology][10]

## **Improving**
## patient outcomes

**Biotts’ MTC-Y™ technology completely changes what is possible with Transdermal Drug Delivery,
making it a much more feasible alternative. **

It offers the fast onset of action of an injectable, but at more constant drug levels and in a way
that is much less invasive. Furthermore, it allows for reduced administration frequency and
increased self-administration, and with that improved quality of life for patients. It also offers
the convenience of an oral pill, but with a much more controlled and sustained release profile,
improved bioavailability, and dramatically reduced side-effects. The results are a significantly
improved performance compared to existing transdermal and topical products, and unlimited
opportunities for new transdermal product development.

The Science

### What Makes Chitosan Different?

**Chitosan** is a natural substance and a **biopolymer** derived from chitin. Chitin is the second
most abundant natural material after cellulose. It is a structural sugar found in shellfish shells,
insect exoskeletons, fungi and certain algae.

Unlike most naturally occurring sugars, chitosan can carry a **positive charge**. Many pathogens,
microplastics, dietary fats, heavy metals and other unwanted compounds are negatively charged.

+

This electrostatic difference allows chitosan to attract, bind or interact with many negatively
charged substances across biological and environmental systems.

This makes chitosan particularly valuable in antimicrobial systems, digestive-health formulations,
toxin-binding applications, water purification, agriculture and advanced biomedical materials.

Functional Benefits

### How Chitosan Supports Health and Purification

Chitosan's polymer structure and ionic activity make it useful in several important health,
nutritional and environmental applications.

Chitosan may serve as a natural dietary fiber ingredient that supports digestive-health and gut
microbiome formulations for humans and animals.

Digestive Health

Its polymer structure enables chitosan powder to interact with toxins and other unwanted compounds
within digestive and purification systems.

Binding Technology
03

#### Heavy Metal Removal

making it valuable in environmental purification.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.

wherever they are.

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.
