Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

1970

### Invented the ComboPen® platform

Invented the ComboPen® platform to deliver medical countermeasures, which fueled autoinjector
innovations for anaphylaxis.

1959

### Created the emergency use autoinjector

Created the emergency use autoinjector, laying the groundwork for the ongoing refinement of
self-administered injectables currently used by millions of people worldwide.

1956

### Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI)

Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI) and kick-started the evolution of inhaled
therapies by developing an easy-to-use device for patients around the globe.

## History of Kindeva

Since 1956, we have been developing technologies that meet the demands of today and deliver the
possibilities of tomorrow.

2024

### Developing low-GWP inhalers

Developing low-GWP inhalers and planning the opening of one of the first commercial-scale green
propellant lines for filling inhalers using propellants with up to 99.9% lower GWP than current
options.

2012

### Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI

Invented the CFC-free nasal MDI**,** a more environmentally sound device for drug delivery capable
of bypassing the blood-brain barrier.

[Analytical testing of plastic syringe for USP 661.2 compliance – Kindeva lab]

2010

### Developed the first commercially available dose counter

Developed the first commercially available dose counter, ensuring patients knew the number of
inhaler actuations remaining so they could always be prepared.

2009

### Created the TruJect™ platform

Created the TruJect™ platform and introduced the next generation of easy and reliable single-chamber
autoinjectors, widely used to deliver a variety of medications.

2005

### Solid microneedle array patch development

Solid microneedle array patch development, creating accurate, reliable intradermal delivery with the
potential to eliminate cold-chain storage and enhance immunogenicity and efficacy.

2002

### Invented the BinaJect® platform

Invented the BinaJect® platform, bringing an industry-leading dual-chamber autoinjector option to
market with enhanced stability and bioavailability.

1995

### Launched the CFC-free MDI

Launched the CFC-free MDI and set the standard for future care options developed to help safeguard
the environment.

1989

### Developed the breath-actuated inhaler

Developed the breath-actuated inhaler, a lifesaving option for individuals with hand-breath
coordination problems that make traditional inhalers difficult to use.

1970

### Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch

Launched the drug-in-adhesive patch, providing a noninvasive method for delivering a drug over an
extended timeframe.

1970

### Invented the ComboPen® platform

Invented the ComboPen® platform to deliver medical countermeasures, which fueled autoinjector
innovations for anaphylaxis.

1959

### Created the emergency use autoinjector

Created the emergency use autoinjector, laying the groundwork for the ongoing refinement of
self-administered injectables currently used by millions of people worldwide.

1956

### Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI)

Invented the pressurized metered‑dose inhaler (pMDI) and kick-started the evolution of inhaled
therapies by developing an easy-to-use device for patients around the globe.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

### About Conference



After a successful conference of Pharmaceutica 2025, Pharma Conferences team cordially invites
participants from all over the world to attend **"27^{th} International Conference and Exhibition on
Pharmaceutics & Novel Drug Delivery Systems" **slated on August 20-21, 2026 in London, UK .
This [Pharmaceutics Conference][82] includes a wide range of Keynote presentations, Oral talks,
Poster presentations, Symposia, Workshops, Exhibitions and Career development programs.

[Novel drug delivery systems Conference][83] is one of the well-established conference
among [Pharmaceutical Conferences][84] organized by Conference Series

Pharmaceutica 2026 covers various aspects of Bio-Pharmaceutics, [Pharmaceutical Chemistry][85], Drug
Targeting and Design, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics in Drugs, Pharmaceutical Formulation,
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing, Pharmaceutical Nanotechnology, [Novel Drug Delivery Systems][86],
Smart Drug Delivery Systems, [Nano medicine][87] and Biomedical Applications, Biomaterials in Drug
Delivery, Vaccine Drug Delivery Systems, Medical Devices for [Drug Delivery][88], Biologics
& [Biosimilars][89], Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Process Validation, Pharmaceutical
Packaging, [Clinical Trials][90] and [Clinical Research][91], Pharmacogenetics and Genomics,
Regulatory Affairs and Intellectual Property Rights, Industrial and Physical Pharmacy, Clinical and
Hospital Pharmacy, [Pharmacovigilance][92] and Drug Safety, Pharmacy Education and Practice

**2026 Highlights:**
* 200+ Participation (70% Industry: 30% Academia)
* 9+ Keynote Speakers
* 30+ Plenary Speakers
* 3+ Exhibitors
* 14 Innovative Educational Sessions
* B2B Meetings

# Innovative Transdermal Technologies and Patient-Focused Pharmaceutical Products

[FIND OUT MORE ][17]

## Nutriband Company

At Nutriband and our subsidiaries, our core focus is to use innovative drug delivery systems and
devices to improve patient outcomes, specifically targeting the Global Opioid epidemic. Fentanyl and
other opioid-based transdermal medications unfortunately play a role in a significant number of
opioid deaths each year with no solution currently available. Working with our clinical
subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, we have developed a technology called AVERSA, which we believe, with FDA
approval, will revolutionize the safety standard for these medications and save countless lives per
year.

## DEVELOPING PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS

## Research & Innovation

Through our Clinical Subsidiary 4P Therapeutics, Our Company has capabilities for developing
pharmaceutical products from preclinical testing to clinical manufacturing and early-stage clinical
development (Phase I/II). A key company focus and area of expertise at 4P is in the development of
transdermal products for currently injected compounds, including proteins, peptides, macromolecules,
and biologics. Transdermal delivery of commercially available drugs or biologics that are typically
delivered by injection has the potential to improve safety, efficacy and therapeutic outcomes
associated with these treatments.

[home.jpg]

## Nutriband Subsidiaries

At Nutriband, we have two revenue-generating subsidiaries, 4P Therapeutics which focuses on clinical
research and development, and Pocono Pharmaceutical, which focuses on contract manufacturing, along
with Active Intelligence, which specializes in sports recovery products.

[home1.jpg]

4P Therapeutics is a clinical subsidiary of Nutriband Inc. (NTRB) focused on the research and
development of novel drug delivery technologies and therapeutics. 4P develops products that meet the
needs of patients, physicians and payers.

# PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

PassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery
SystemPassPort® Novel Transdermal Drug Delivery System

**Advanced microporation technology for the delivery of therapeutics and vaccines **

[Contact Us][20]

## The PassPort® System

[Transdermal comparison to oral drug delivery]

#### Why Transdermal Drug Delivery?

 Passive transdermal drug delivery is a convenient and effective way to administer a variety of
therapeutics. This route of administration is both noninvasive and produces steady drug delivery
over an extended period of time. 



While conventional transdermal systems (such as drug patches) have demonstrated the benefits of
delivering drugs via the skin, they only work for an extremely limited number of drugs. This is
because millions of dead skin cells form a protective barrier on the surface of the skin (the
stratum corneum) that prevents most therapeutic molecules from passing into the skin. Passive
transdermal patches are typically limited to lipid-soluble drugs with a molecular weight of less
than 500 daltons.



As a result of these limitations, researchers have explored a variety of methods to penetrate this
skin barrier - ranging from chemicals to lasers, microneedles, and ultrasound. However, many of
these technologies have drawbacks or other limitations. PassPort Technologies, Inc. is looking to
overcome these challenges via a novel transdermal microporation platform called the PassPort®
system.



[PassPort System - advanced drug delivery technology]

#### PassPort® Microporation Technology

The PassPort® system is a novel active transdermal technology platform that enables efficient
delivery of small molecule drugs, peptides, proteins, carbohydrates, nucleotides, and vaccines from
a small conventional skin patch.



The patented system is designed for simple application and self-administration. Pressing the
activation button of the applicator device releases a pulse of energy to the disposable porator. The
rapid conduction of this energy into the surface of the skin painlessly ablates the stratum corneum
under each porator filament to create microchannels. A simple transdermal patch containing the
active ingredient is then applied to the ablated skin and drug delivery begins. 



[How the PassPort System works]

#### How the Technology Works

 The PassPort® technology painlessly creates aqueous micropores in the stratum corneum within a few
milliseconds. These aqueous channels enable drugs to flow from a transdermal patch, enter the viable
epidermis, and then the systemic circulation. The patch may be formulated to provide for either
immediate or sustained delivery.



PassPort Technologies is developing transdermal alternatives to invasive injection formulations…
* Better patient compliance (needle-free drug delivery)
* Convenient for patients (at-home administration)
* Improvement of storage conditions (room temperature) using a dry patch formulation
* Easy dose discontinuation by patch removal
* Economically attractive costs of goods 
* Reduces needle disposal and needlestick injuries
* Improved pharmacoeconomics (reduced healthcare costs)
* New feature: electronic medication adherence control

## Pipeline



PassPort Technologies is developing a robust internal pipeline of off-patent drugs delivered via the
novel PassPort® system. The company's lead preclinical candidate is a CNS therapeutic in development
in the US via the 505(b)(2) pathway. This candidate is available for license.



In addition, PassPort Technologies has ongoing collaborations with leading multinational
pharmaceutical companies and academic groups. Details on these pipeline PassPort® candidates are
currently undisclosed.

# Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK | MHRA-Licensed Exporter to Africa and the Middle East

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is a pharmaceutical wholesaler UK and international buyers turn to
for compliant, export-ready medicines. We hold a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human) from the
MHRA and run to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards, from the point a product is sourced to
the day it leaves our facility near London Heathrow.
We buy from approved UK and European suppliers, hold stock in temperature-controlled storage, and
build each consignment with the paperwork institutional buyers and regulators actually ask for:

certificates of analysis, batch traceability, temperature logs, and full export documentation. Under
our licence we procure, hold, and export medicines to other businesses, never directly to the
public, and a designated Responsible Person oversees GDP compliance. We’re a licensed distributor
and exporter, not a manufacturer.

[Request GDP-Compliant Export Documentation][17]

## Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK With Global Export Reach

GPD has spent years coordinating supply for authorised importers, hospital groups, and government
health programmes in more than one region. Most of what we do is invisible to the patient at the end
of the chain, and that’s by design. Buyers stay with us because shipments arrive documented,
traceable, and ready for inspection, not because of a sales pitch.
Every product follows the same route: verified sourcing, GDP storage, and consignment preparation
under Responsible Person oversight, exactly as a WDA(H) requires. The MHRA inspects licensed sites
against GDP before a licence is granted and at intervals afterwards, so the standard is never
optional.

# Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK | MHRA-Licensed Exporter to Africa and the Middle East

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is a pharmaceutical wholesaler UK and international buyers turn to
for compliant, export-ready medicines. We hold a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human) from the
MHRA and run to Good Distribution Practice (GDP) standards, from the point a product is sourced to
the day it leaves our facility near London Heathrow.
We buy from approved UK and European suppliers, hold stock in temperature-controlled storage, and
build each consignment with the paperwork institutional buyers and regulators actually ask for:

certificates of analysis, batch traceability, temperature logs, and full export documentation. Under
our licence we procure, hold, and export medicines to other businesses, never directly to the
public, and a designated Responsible Person oversees GDP compliance. We’re a licensed distributor
and exporter, not a manufacturer.

## Pharmaceutical Wholesaler UK With Global Export Reach

GPD has spent years coordinating supply for authorised importers, hospital groups, and government
health programmes in more than one region. Most of what we do is invisible to the patient at the end
of the chain, and that’s by design. Buyers stay with us because shipments arrive documented,
traceable, and ready for inspection, not because of a sales pitch.
Every product follows the same route: verified sourcing, GDP storage, and consignment preparation
under Responsible Person oversight, exactly as a WDA(H) requires. The MHRA inspects licensed sites
against GDP before a licence is granted and at intervals afterwards, so the standard is never
optional.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

# Welcome to the Research & Reviews - International Journals

We are an open-access journal publication that aims to serve authors and readers (scientists as well
as general masses) by providing them an easy and reliable source of knowledge. We publish 28
International Journals dispersing advance knowledge in the field of Pharmacy, Medical, Nursing,
Dental, Agriculture, Engineering Technology and Arts. Certified by American Montessori Council, we
have developed a unique education system that is a blend of our Ancient Vedic Educations with the
practice equipment of Montessori system.

We provide a wide range of standard articles that are published after a stringent peer-review
process along with expert’s updations and are appreciated by millions of readers all over the world
for our unbiased performance and quality output. Several countries contribute papers to our
journals. Each issue carries useful reviews and articles of immediate interest to the practicing
professionals as well as researchers.

# Welcome to the Research & Reviews - International Journals

We are an open-access journal publication that aims to serve authors and readers (scientists as well
as general masses) by providing them an easy and reliable source of knowledge. We publish 28
International Journals dispersing advance knowledge in the field of Pharmacy, Medical, Nursing,
Dental, Agriculture, Engineering Technology and Arts. Certified by American Montessori Council, we
have developed a unique education system that is a blend of our Ancient Vedic Educations with the
practice equipment of Montessori system.

We provide a wide range of standard articles that are published after a stringent peer-review
process along with expert’s updations and are appreciated by millions of readers all over the world
for our unbiased performance and quality output. Several countries contribute papers to our
journals. Each issue carries useful reviews and articles of immediate interest to the practicing
professionals as well as researchers.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule

helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
